ebm.title: Climate Lab
ebm.description: Runs globally on this branch’s existing geological mesh. Trial settings and results stay in this map session and do not change the world.

ebm.name: EBM
ebm.help: The energy balance model runs Dreamulator’s fast climate solver and provides annual and monthly layers.

eps.name: EPS
eps.help: A WebGPU reimplementation of ExoPlaSim that simulates atmospheric circulation one time step at a time. (In development)

epsPlus.name: EPS++
epsPlus.help: An extension of EPS with coupled processes such as dynamic ocean currents. (In development)
